text: The sterile brightness of the glass-walled room evokes a sense of anticipation—perhaps a meeting or discussion is about to form, each empty chair hinting at human stories yet to unfold. Then, as I wander into the next space filled with vivid color and talk of 'R+D,' curiosity swells in me. These are places of thought, invention, and possibility. I feel inspired, yet humbled by the promise and challenge of shaping the future.
